questions.question: Which soon-to-be Championship side (if half the Premier League get their way) recently found themselves up in court lodging a formal legal appeal against their financial rule charges?
questions.explanation: Manchester City formally lodged an appeal regarding their ongoing Premier League financial charges, providing endless banter for opposing terraces across the country.
questions.anchorClues: Manchester City legal appeal / financial charges

questions.question: Which legendary Liverpool goalkeeper, celebrating his birthday today, famously threw off Roma penalty takers with his iconic 'spaghetti legs' routine during the 1984 European Cup final shootout?
questions.explanation: Born on 6 October 1957, Bruce Grobbelaar wrote himself into European football folklore with his wobbly-legged distraction tactics in Rome.
questions.anchorClues: Bruce Grobbelaar birthday / spaghetti legs 1984 European Cup final

questions.question: Which side remarkably found themselves sitting 3rd from bottom in 18th place heading into the October 2026 international break?
questions.explanation: Coventry City sat in 18th place on 3 points as the league paused for October international fixtures.
questions.anchorClues: Coventry City 18th position / October 2026 Premier League table

questions.question: Which Premier League side suffered a chaotic 4–2 defeat to Brighton before the international break, despite taking an early lead, leading their manager to publicly criticise their defensive structure?
questions.explanation: Enzo Maresca's Chelsea were blown away 4–2 by Brighton in an open top-flight thriller just before the international pause.
questions.anchorClues: Chelsea 4-2 loss to Brighton / pre-international break

questions.question: Which former Premier League midfielder holds the record for scoring against the highest number of different individual clubs in top-flight history, finding the net against 39 distinct teams?
questions.explanation: Frank Lampard scored against 39 different Premier League opponents during his legendary careers at West Ham, Chelsea, and Manchester City.
questions.anchorClues: Frank Lampard 39 different clubs scored against record

questions.question: Which manager recorded the highest ever total points tally in a single Premier League debut season, accumulating 95 points in 2004–05?
questions.explanation: José Mourinho announced himself to English football by collecting 95 points and conceding just 15 goals in his magnificent first campaign with Chelsea.
questions.anchorClues: José Mourinho 95 points debut season record 2004-05

questions.question: Which squad number was famously assigned to Eric Cantona, David Beckham, and Cristiano Ronaldo at Manchester United, and remains our permanent Floor 7 answer?
questions.explanation: The iconic number 7 shirt at Old Trafford is steeped in terrace history and serves as the permanent easter egg answer for Floor 7.

questions.question: Which referee holds the all-time record for issuing the most red cards in Premier League history, sending off 89 players across his top-flight officiating career?
questions.explanation: Mike Dean handed out 89 red cards during his 560 Premier League matches between 2000 and 2022.

questions.question: Which club scored 102 Premier League goals in the 2009–10 campaign, becoming the first side in top-flight history to breach the 100-goal mark in a single season?
questions.explanation: Carlo Ancelotti's Chelsea smashed the top-flight scoring barrier with 102 goals on their way to the 2009–10 double.

questions.question: Which individual holds the rare distinction of winning the Premier League title as both a player and a manager at the same club?
questions.explanation: No person has ever won the Premier League title as both a player and manager at the *same* club (Kenny Dalglish won as player-manager before the Premier League era, and as a manager with Blackburn).
questions.anchorClues: Nobody Premier League player and manager same club trick question
